decision.rationale: Fold 003 remains immutable completed-refine evidence. The audit closes three prospective defects and registers a coherent guarded policy-value successor on fresh evidence. It does not rescore Fold 003 or select a release architecture.

provider_semantic_failures.cause: Schema-valid non-authoritative reason_code values exceeded the local 128-character contract.

interpretation: C repaired much of B's model-only collapse but did not outperform deterministic A on continuous hidden utility.
C+V's reject-only verifier suppressed valid interventions and should not advance.
The exact single preferred action is a useful agreement diagnostic but is not equivalent to whether a transition is authorized and pedagogically valid.
A safe successor should begin from deterministic A and permit a model-assisted change only when an inspectable value model independently agrees and predicts a material utility gain.

findings.title: Non-authoritative provider rationale exceeded the local contract
findings.closure: HierarchicalPlanningProposalV1 and PlannerVerificationV1 now normalize over-length reason codes into a readable bounded prefix plus deterministic SHA-256 suffix before local validation. Authoritative action, evidence, and policy fields are unchanged.

findings.title: Fold 003 provisional ranking omitted continuous policy utility
findings.closure: No architecture was selected from Fold 003, so the ordering caused no release decision. The successor runner reports utility and regret and applies the complete preregistered paired rule before naming a confirmation candidate.

findings.title: Exact preferred-action agreement was conflated with transition validity
findings.closure: The fresh successor defines deterministic event/action-envelope validity as the hard transition gate, retains exact preferred-action agreement as a diagnostic, and uses hidden continuous utility/regret as the primary pedagogical comparison.

limitations: The hidden utility oracle is synthetic and does not establish real learning improvement.
The post-hoc diagnostic analysis explains Fold 003 but cannot change its metrics, gates, or decision.
The successor requires fresh execution and confirmation before release selection.
